location_note: Southern slope of Mount Scopus below the Hebrew University campus (Yitzhaq Ha-Nadiv St. tunnel); map ref. NIG 2224-34/6328-34, OIG 1724-34/1328-34.
notes: 2000 excavation, Areas A1-A3: Iron Age quarry; two plastered rock-hewn cisterns in the quarry (Installation II later turned into a miqveh), Hasmonean; six loculus burial caves of the late Second Temple period revealed during the works (access forbidden, opened and closed; Cave 6 partly recorded); Ottoman watchtower. Ten previously documented caves (Kloner, Abu-Raya, Weksler-Bdolah, Stark) cited; not coded; Cave 11 status unclear, not coded.

features.subtype: extensive stone quarry with rock-cut scarps and detached ashlars (Areas A1-A3)
features.period: end of the Iron Age (homogeneous sherds); later sherds washed in
features.quote: A homogenous assemblage of sherds from the end of the Iron Age

features.subtype: plastered rock-hewn cisterns: Installation I (3.5 m deep) and the first phase of Installation II
features.period: Hasmonean (Late Hellenistic sherds in the fills)
features.quote: two water cisterns, one of which was later converted into a miqveh

features.subtype: cistern converted into a miqveh by an L-shaped staircase and replastering (Installation II)
features.period: Hasmonean sherds in fill and under the stairs; type common in the Second Temple period
features.quote: an L-shaped staircase was hewn in its eastern wall, thus converting it

features.eos: inspected (opened and promptly closed; access forbidden)
features.subtype: six loculus (kokhim) burial caves revealed during the roadworks
features.period: end of the Second Temple period
features.quote: all of which date to the end of the Second Temple period
